BJECTIVES FOR THE 1/9-5 WELL ARE THE EKOFISK AND TOR CHALK FORMATIONS. HYDROCARBONS HAVE BEEN ENCOUNTERED IN THESE FORMATIONS IN THE 1/9-4 WELL. AND SIMILAR CONDITIONS ARE EXPECTED TO OCCUR AT THE 1/9-5 LOCATION. DRILLING HAZARDS SWELLING CLAYS ARE EXPECTED FROM 400 DOWN TO TOP DANIAN CHALK. DRILLING RATE SHOULD BE CONTROLLED TO AVOID MUD RINGS AND STICKING PROBLEMS. SITE SURVEY INDICATES NO GAS IN SHALLOW INTERVALS.

jectives for the 1/9-5 well are the Ekofisk and Tor chalk formations. Hydrocarbons have been encountered in these formations in the 1/9-4 well, and similar conditions are expected to occur at the 1/9-5 location. Drilling Hazards. Swelling clays are expected from 400 down to Top Danian Chalk. Drilling rate should be controlled to avoid mud rings and sticking problems. No shallow gas are observable on the site survey.
